LookML Project Files
🔍
Drop .lkml files here
Upload one .model.lkml + one or more .view.lkml files
Relationships are lazy (join on demand). Physical joins are eager (always joined).
🤖 AI key for formula conversion (optional — converts complex sql expressions)
Without a key, simple patterns (ROUND, DATEDIFF, column = 1, CASE WHEN) are converted automatically. Complex expressions need a key.

SSAS/MSAS Cube JSON
🧊
Drop SSAS Cube JSON here
SQL Server Management Studio export · or paste below
What gets converted:
• MeasureGroups → Sigma fact elements with metrics
• Dimensions → Sigma dimension elements with columns
• KPIs → Value + Goal metrics (status/trend documented)
• Hierarchies → RaggedHierarchy() column stubs + warnings
• Dynamic sets → MovingSum / DateLookback guidance
• Perspectives → documented as workbook page suggestions
